Zork I · Sega Saturn · Japan · 1996

Great Underground Plates

Every pre-rendered room background on the disc, pulled out of the eleven B*.CGL archives on data track 1 and matched to the rooms that display it. The plates are 8-bit and 320×240, each carrying its own 256-colour palette, which is why every region of the map is graded a different colour.

75plates
19item pictures
110rooms
11archives
31CD-DA tracks
320×240every plate

How a room finds its plate

A .CGL is a chain of 4-byte-aligned records: a 512-byte RGB555 palette followed by an LZSS stream that expands to one 320×240 frame. 0ZORK.BIN carries a 16-byte presentation record per room at file offset 0x75060, and the loader at 0x0600b180 fetches the frame as cgl_buffer + record[+12] + 512, stepping over the frame’s own palette.

FieldTypeMeaning
+0u16CD-DA track number, 0 for silence
+2u16Sound-effect bank index
+4u16Archive index, alphabetical
+6u16Unused, always zero
+8u32Byte length of the frame record
+12u32Byte offset of the frame record

Item pictures

Unlike the room plates, these come out of OITEM.CZ — a container holding nineteen LZSS streams of 5120 bytes (64×80 at 8bpp) followed by nineteen 512-byte CLUTs, one per picture. They are the objects the game shows in the inventory panel. Disc order; the names the game attaches to them are not decoded yet.

Sound

Field +0 of the same room record is a raw disc track number. The room-change handler at 0x06048c1c hands it to the looping player at 0x0602a4d8, which fills a CDC play spec with start track / index 1, end track / index 99, mode 0x0F — repeat until the room changes. A second player at 0x0602a578 is identical apart from mode 0x00, play once. Twelve of the thirty-one audio tracks are room music; ten rooms play nothing at all.

Ten rooms are scored silent (track 0): Barrow Entrance, Grating Room, Atlantis Room, Base of Dam, Slide Room and all five Frigid River rooms. Playback volume comes from a per-track byte table at 0x0608ef74 — 127 everywhere except track 32, which is set to zero.

Extracted from Zork I - The Great Underground Empire (Japan) (Track 01).bin. Four room titles — 0, 5, 41 and 92 — live inside multi-part message banks rather than as plain strings, and were resolved from the bank text plus the room’s archive. BBAR_01 is the one plate no room references; it belongs to the HUS_BAR.TPG transition.
